## yapmod v0.3.0

This release is about the things you use every day: notifications, voice calls, and keeping yapmod up to date.

### What's new

- **Notifications and mentions.** Unread counts and mention badges now show up on servers and channels, and yapmod can show desktop notifications and play notification sounds. This works on Windows, macOS and Linux.
- **Voice calls on macOS.** macOS now asks for microphone access the first time you join a call. Allow it and your microphone works.
- **Update notices.** yapmod checks for new versions and tells you when one is available. You can turn the automatic check off in settings.
- **Changelog in settings.** Read the notes for every yapmod release without leaving the app.
- **A documentation site.** Setup, first-launch, troubleshooting, FAQ and developer docs now live on the website, with full-text search.

### Fixed

- Switching settings sections no longer leaves the previous panel visible.
- Settings from older yapmod versions now carry over correctly.
- The Linux app uses the proper Tux icon.

### If your microphone still does not work

Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone**, enable **yapmod**, and relaunch. If yapmod is not listed, run this in Terminal and relaunch:

```bash
tccutil reset Microphone io.ilyeshdz.yapmod
```

### Install

Download the build for your platform below. macOS builds are ad-hoc signed but not notarized, so right-click **yapmod** and choose **Open** the first time.
